## What changed?

Describe the smallest useful change.

## Claim or rule affected

Which statement does this change challenge, tighten, add, or remove?

## Evidence / test

What independent evidence, reproducible test, benchmark, derivation, or counterexample supports it?

## Failure mode addressed

What could go wrong without this change?

## What would falsify this change?

What evidence would show that this proposal is wrong or worse?

## Reversibility

Is the change easy to inspect and revert?

- [ ] Small enough to review
- [ ] Evidence or test included where appropriate
- [ ] No unrelated rewrite
- [ ] README remains a ~5-minute read
- [ ] Rule 0 applied to this PR
